cost_definition: T95 = compiled full-evolution T count * QPE full-evolution queries * independent attempts for 95% success
selection: All training cases and all testing cases with compiled baseline/ELOTE cost estimates. HF-18 is included in the testing histogram despite its baseline accuracy failure, which is disclosed in the manuscript.
histogram_normalization: All 191 Hamiltonians with compiled cost estimates, percentages sum to 100 across the two stacked datasets.
panel_a: Unchanged compiled per-rotation tolerances and T counts from elote115_figure2.npz.

baseline_accuracy_failures.baseline_cost_semantics: Recorded diagnostic T95 cost uses QPE precision equal to chemical accuracy when the compiled baseline is infeasible. It does not imply successful chemically accurate QPE.
